steps.noticeHtml:
How we use your information

The New Normal (“Normal”) collects the details in this form to:

  1. review your application and decide whether you’re a good fit
  2. contact you about Normal and contact you for next steps, such as a chat/interview
  3. set you up as a member if you join

Only the leaders handling recruitment can see your answers. We don’t sell your information or share it outside Normal. Our form and storage tools may keep data outside Singapore, and we choose providers with strong protection.

If you don’t join us, we delete your details no later than 3 years after recruitment closes. If you join, they become part of your member record.

You can ask to see or correct your information, or withdraw your consent, at any time. Email us at hello@newnormal.sg with “Data request” in the subject line. If you withdraw before recruitment ends, we may not be able to consider your application.
